subject: VM scan coverage & evidence request — gap analysis and attestation needed
messages:
From: security@finmore.com
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: auditor@brightaudits.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: vulnerability management coverage + evidence for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this. As part of FinMore's quarterly supplier SIG and SOC 2 review we need a concise packet demonstrating Redwood's vulnerability management posture. Specifically we need:

- A scan-coverage matrix showing which assets are in-scope for authenticated vulnerability scanning (internal, external, container images, orchestration plane, OS, third-party libs).
- The cadence for each scan class (frequency and typical start times).
- The SLA for triage and remediation by severity (we need your internal definition of Critical/High/Medium/Low mapped to CVSS ranges you use).
- A short attestation on business letterhead that Critical CVEs will be triaged within X hours and remediated or mitigated within Y days unless exempted by an agreed compensating control.
- For any open Critical/Higher CVEs in the last 12 months, an example remediation evidence bundle (ticket links, patch commits, or change request references).

Can you send a preliminary response by EOD Thursday? Auditor has requested a short call after we review the packet. I've attached our questionnaire (FinMore-VM-questionnaire.xlsx) with the fields we'd like populated.

Regards,
Mark Ellis
Security Operations Lead
FinMore Capital
security@finmore.com

[Attachment: FinMore-VM-questionnaire.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
To: security@finmore.com
Cc: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management coverage + evidence for SOC 2 / SIG

Mark — thanks for the clear list. We'll take this on. Quick plan:

1) I'll own collection and delivery of the evidence packet.
2) Jordan will pull the scan-coverage matrix and map asset tags to our authenticated scanning scope.
3) Kimberly will prepare the draft attestation language for legal review (we can provide a PDF on letterhead).

Questions before we deliver:
- Do you want authenticated container image scans tied to registry image digests (we can include image:tag + digest) or just repo-level coverage?
- For the remediation examples, is a redacted ticket + pull request + CI job sufficient, or do you require database-level patch signatures?

Target timeline: preliminary packet (matrix + cadence + SLA table) by Thu 2025-08-21 EOD; attestation + evidence bundle (sample tickets) by Mon 2025-08-25. If you need it sooner we can accelerate but will need confirmation on the image-scan scope.

I'll attach the draft scope CSV for Jordan to update and send over.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, security@finmore.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: vulnerability management coverage + evidence for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Mark / Monica — Jordan here (security engineering). Below is a concise snapshot you can include in the packet; I'll export the full coverage matrix to CSV for your review.

Scan coverage (summary):
- External perimeter: authenticated + unauthenticated network scans against public IPs and load balancers (weekly).
- Internal hosts: authenticated credentials-based scans for managed instances via our scanner agent (host-based) — cadence: fortnightly (every 14 days).
- Container images: registry image scan on push + weekly scheduled full-registry sweep (we will include image:tag + digest as requested).
- IaC and orchestration: static analysis of IaC templates on PR + weekly drift scans for orchestration plane components.
- Third-party libs (apps): SBOM-driven SCA scans daily for newly published CVEs with weekly re-eval.

SLA (our standard remediation policy):
- Critical (CVSS 9.0-10.0 or exploit observed in wild): triage within 48 hours; mitigation or patch in 14 calendar days unless a documented exemption approved by Security and Product.
- High (CVSS 7.0-8.9): triage within 5 business days; remediation in 30 calendar days.
- Medium (CVSS 4.0-6.9): triage within 10 business days; remediation in 90 calendar days.
- Low (CVSS 0.1-3.9): tracked with routine patch windows and risk-accepted when applicable.

Notes on exceptions: We maintain a documented exception workflow (ticket with compensating controls, risk acceptance, owner, and expiry). Exceptions are reviewed monthly.

Example evidence (we will attach one redacted example):
- Ticket: SEC-2025-2091 (redacted) — shows detection (scanner output), assigned owner, remediation PR link, and deployment note.
- Commit: github.com/redwoodinference/platform/commit/abc123patch — includes patch and unit test.
- CI: build job 5423 — shows the security gate passing post-PR.

Deliverables we'll upload to the Drive folder: coverage-matrix.csv, sla-table.md, example-evidence-bundle.zip (redacted).

Jordan Blake
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
